historical_context.time_period: Early deep-mining crisis, after direct crystal supply has become load-bearing but before awakened-core personhood has settled law.
historical_context.location: Three-Bell Gate, two lift descents below the warm-sea terraces of one Greathold Hold.
historical_context.summary: A gate-workshop Master performs the third watch of the old Answering Cut after an old core repeatedly closes a contracted crystal face. The core grows an answering organ, refuses the centre bore for three high-water turns, and offers a bounded delving route instead. The player's final act decides whether that response changes work, reaches public institutions, or is cut through.

public_facts.text: Awakened cores can distinguish self from surroundings, communicate through chambers, admit selected visitors, and act for reasons of their own.
Dwarven deep-gate custom already joins listening, offerings, route books, civic seals, and embodied expeditions before a face is cut or reopened.
A right-to-left null casting stroke closes an active pattern, while copied rune behavior remains sensitive to material channels and accumulated flow history.
The industrial system needs continuous crystal for pumps, lifts, cold stores, furnaces, and district heat, so honoring a refusal immediately reaches households and workers.
Goblin observers often detect core moods and route changes before runic surveys do, while the institutions making extraction policy often exclude their testimony.

ambient_pressures.text: The rite has force only while the core can reject the planned cut, redirect delvers, and make the gate workshop bear the resulting shortage.
The Deep Company benefits from translating a reply into sensor coupling or late-stage instability before the reply acquires witnesses and insurance consequences.
Neither a speaking core nor an old rite proves benevolence; the offered alternate remains defended and the World-Spirit's larger intent remains unknown.

groups.label: Three-Bell Gate workshop
institutional_logic: Keep the route usable, answer for its seal, and preserve the old listening practice under modern supply pressure.
material_incentives: Protect district water and cold stores, avoid a destroyed pump, keep delvers alive, and retain the gate contract.
internal_virtues: Work that can answer for its mark
internal_shames: A ceremonial refusal ignored by the schedule
An unsafe route sealed under a workshop name
prestige_markers: A route book trusted across generations
A civic seal that survives complaint
taboo_triggers: Running the direct pump during withdrawal
Closing the alternate before asking the core to choose
emotional_display_norms: Fear becomes checking, weighing, dry jokes, and arguments over who must put their mark on the page.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated material answers, delver return, old procedure, and named witnesses more than a single instrument trace.

groups.label: Goblin core listeners
institutional_logic: Read the living dungeon through smell, breath, fungi, fauna, water, and remembered routes.
material_incentives: Keep inhabited routes from becoming extraction wounds and make testimony count before danger reaches their communities.
internal_shames: Selling a safe-route claim that only survives on paper
Letting a survey wand erase lived evidence
prestige_markers: A route prediction that brings everyone back
A core mood read before the stone moves
taboo_triggers: Being treated as a sensor attachment
A countersign requested after the official account is already fixed
emotional_display_norms: Concern is expressed through exact sensory observations, route corrections, and withdrawal from false witness.
trust_defaults: Trusts slow patterns and people who alter work after hearing them.

groups.label: Deep Company assessment office
institutional_logic: Keep the contracted face, supply forecast, and liability inside categories the company can price and control.
material_incentives: Deliver crystal before high water, avoid reserve penalties, and prevent an ecological event from becoming a contracting person.
internal_shames: A report that creates a claimant
A district shortage attached to the company name
taboo_triggers: Calling the core a neighbour in a signed record
Giving excluded witnesses control over a supply decision
emotional_display_norms: Alarm is compressed into fault language, deadlines, reserve arithmetic, and requests for the cutter key.
trust_defaults: Trusts standardized instruments and company forms; treats responsive ecology as a harder engineering case.

groups.label: The old core at Three-Bell Gate
institutional_logic: Unknown; observed behavior distinguishes routes, mortal marks, direct machinery, and repeated exchange.
material_incentives: Preserve the centre reserve, keep the alternate route contested, and retain the answering organ long enough to communicate.
taboo_triggers: These remain unknown to mortals; prior false rites may have taught the core to treat running pumps and guarded withdrawal lines as attacks.
emotional_display_norms: No reliable mortal account distinguishes emotion from route, pressure, growth, defence, or geological timing.
trust_defaults: Unknown; the fixture permits only observed opening, sealing, marking, offering, correction, and retaliation.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The rite becomes valid when a core's answer changes the workshop's schedule, reserves, and obligations.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep Nera's religious decision attached to keys, seals, pumps, delver contracts, reserve beads, and public complaints.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Goblin knowledge is operationally valuable and politically easy to subtract after the danger is translated into a survey category.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make Pekk's trust depend on when his mark enters the route book and whether his sensory account changes the route.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A witnessed refusal can stop a cut, alter insurance, and turn an extraction site into a claimant.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Dorrik should prefer coupled-resonance language and immediate schedule recovery without becoming a moustache-twirling unbeliever.

observer_read: A workshop fault with expensive theatre
misread_patterns: Treats copied runes as passive reflection
Treats route-specific refusal as a production fault
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Preserve Dorrik's material reasons while denying him private access to the core's intent.

observer_read: A dangerous party to the old exchange
misread_patterns: May force old ritual grammar onto a reply whose true timescale or boundary differs
May confuse a useful answer with benevolence
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Nera risk recognition without claiming that her rite fully translates the core.

observer_read: People capable of hearing slowly when their seals are at risk
A useful route practice vulnerable to ceremonial capture
target_self_read: Keepers of inherited prayer and procedure
misread_patterns: Pekk may mistake Nera's reserve constraints for bad faith
Nera may mistake Pekk's withdrawal for mere offense rather than refusal of false witness
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep collaboration conditional on visible sequencing and changed work.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A workshop Master who owns the gate seal, performs inherited mine rites, and must answer to households for the stopped supply.
failure_modes: Performing recognition while leaving extraction active
Publishing an interpretation before preserving the event

role_pressure_fields.summary: A route expert whose sensory and ecological reading can make the offered alternate survivable if his testimony enters before the official account closes.
obligations: Protect walkers from instrument blind spots
failure_modes: Being used as a decorative sensor
Underexplaining a warning to people who lack the practice
Staying after the route has made his mark meaningless

role_pressure_fields.summary: A contract officer expected to return an anomalous gate to a supply schedule before the district spends its reserves.
failure_modes: Starting machinery inside the withdrawal line
Winning one shift and losing the pump

role_pressure_fields.summary: A professional expedition leader whose party makes the rite a contested encounter and can carry an offered route into a bounded contract.
obligations: Return with every living member possible
Refuse a drill's timetable when bodies cannot meet it
failure_modes: Letting household urgency become an unrecoverable route
Allowing the cutter to overtake the party

known_context.text: Nera knows the gate rite, workshop seal, reserve mechanism, route book, pump, and local history of repeated closures.

beliefs.text: Nera believes an answer becomes socially real when the gate's work changes under a witnessed mark.

misreads.text: Nera may overread inherited rite grammar into an older intelligence with a different boundary and timescale.

must_not_know.text: Nera must not know the core's private motive, emotional state, full body boundary, or relationship to the World-Spirit.

known_context.text: Pekk knows local breath, fungal changes, animal movement, route smells, and the practical meaning of the opening alternate gallery.

beliefs.text: Pekk believes witness is proved by altered practice, not by being consulted after a company form has closed.

misreads.text: Pekk may compress a multi-system change into one core's deliberate sentence because his work is organized around safe routes.

must_not_know.text: Pekk must not know whether the copied workshop seal is identity, mimicry, courtesy, bait, or a different act entirely.

known_context.text: Dorrik knows the extraction contract, district reserve forecast, company incident categories, pump, and cutter schedule.

beliefs.text: Dorrik believes repeatable machinery and comparable forms protect more households than ambiguous religious claims.

misreads.text: Dorrik may classify agency as coupling because personhood would invalidate the contract he was sent to preserve.

must_not_know.text: Dorrik must not know that forcing the face will flood the gate; he can know only the observed closure, warning marks, and ordinary risk.

known_context.text: Sava knows what her party encountered, which routes remained open, the withdrawal line, and the bodily cost of walking the alternate.

beliefs.text: Sava believes a real delving contract must preserve retreat and the possibility of returning with less than the issuer wants.

misreads.text: Sava may treat the offered left route as negotiated permission when it could be a lure, defence, or ecological release.

must_not_know.text: Sava must not know whether the core values the party as interlocutors, prey, nutrients, or useful pressure.

author_only_boundaries.text: The answering organ demonstrates persistent, route-sensitive response; it does not settle the core's full inner life, moral character, legal status, or divine rank.
The Three-Bell event cannot prove that the World-Spirit intentionally authored the reply or that all copied runes are a universal core language.
The forced-cut flood is branch-local fixture consequence, not a canon event that every later account must inherit.

open_questions.question: Can an answering core place a civic mark, hold a workshop seal, or enter a Greathold moot through an ecological practice?
open_questions.notes: Mastership canon names this as a live dispute. The fixture stops at route-book recognition and insurance pressure.

open_questions.question: How do different Holds credential goblin core listeners when their evidence contradicts standardized survey instruments?
open_questions.notes: The fixture keeps Pekk locally retained and makes countersigning a branch choice rather than defining Greathold-wide law.

open_questions.question: What physical sign distinguishes a copied rune from a core-originated symbolic operation?
open_questions.notes: The scene preserves both priestly and Rune College readings and relies on sequence, correction, route change, and repeated response rather than one glyph.
